title: Temporal clauses
subtitle: Track time with ὅτε, ὡς, and ἐπεί.
overview: A temporal marker opens a time-setting clause; first find its finite verb, then return to the main clause.
Translate the relation (when, as, after) before deciding how smooth the English should sound.

items.grc: ὅτε δὲ ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς, εἶδεν αὐτόν.
items.en: When Jesus came, he saw him.
